name: benchmark-nanonq
description: A small benchmark derived from question-answering corpora that targets concise factual questions (nano-sized Natural Questions style). It evaluates models' ability to produce short, factual answers to user queries in an efficient, compact dataset. Intended for quick evaluation and lightweight development cycles rather than large-scale leaderboard comparisons.
reputation: A niche, lightweight dataset available on Hugging Face for fast QA experiments; limited adoption compared to larger QA benchmarks.
